definitions.explanation: The act of placing a deceased person's body or remains in the ground or a grave. A formal term used in both modern and historical contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{遺体|いたい}→遺体：14433_itai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{教会|きょうかい}→教会：01387_kyoukai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{墓地|ぼち}→墓地：15232_bochi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{埋葬|まいそう}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The body was buried in the church cemetery.

examples.japanese: ⟦{故郷|こきょう}→故郷：02733_kokyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{土地|とち}→土地：02226_tochi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{埋葬|まいそう}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧ほしい⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{遺言|ゆいごん}→遺言：10896_yuigon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{残|のこ}した→残す：01975_nokosu⟧。
examples.english: He left a will requesting to be buried in his homeland.

examples.japanese: {発掘調査|はっくつちょうさ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{数百年前|すうひゃくねんまえ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{埋葬|まいそう}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧とみられる{人骨|じんこつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発見|はっけん}→発見：00085_hakken⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: During the excavation survey, human bones believed to have been buried several hundred years ago were discovered.

notes:
USAGE:
{埋葬|まいそう} is used with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ as a transitive suru-verb. The deceased or remains take ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧, and the location takes ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{遺体|いたい}→遺体：14433_itai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{埋葬|まいそう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to bury a body)
- ⟦{遺骨|いこつ}→遺骨：19163_ikotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{埋葬|まいそう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to inter remains)
- {埋葬地|まいそうち} (burial site)
- {埋葬|まいそう}{許可証|きょかしょう} (burial permit)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {埋葬|まいそう}: burial (formal, neutral)
- {土葬|どそう}: earth burial, inhumation (specifically burying in the ground, as opposed to cremation)
- ⟦{葬|ほうむ}る→葬る：07874_houmuru⟧: to bury, to consign to oblivion (also figurative)
- {納骨|のうこつ}: placing ashes in a tomb or ossuary (after cremation)
